question: Q-binding
name: USGS NWIS site service + series catalog (legacy waterservices)
reason: Works 2026-10-13. siteOutput=expanded+seriesCatalogOutput is rejected (HTTP 400); use basic + seriesCatalogOutput; 404 means no match. siteType LK per state plus ST/ES/SP with reservoir-elevation params 62614/62615/62616/00062/72020/72022.
notes: iv/dv services used for probes and history. Legacy NWIS is scheduled for retirement in favour of the OGC API; see S-binding-002.

question: Q-binding
name: USGS OGC API (api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v0)
reason: Reachable (40 collections) but anonymous use hit OVER_RATE_LIMIT after about 3 requests; a free API key is required for bulk use. Not needed today because the legacy services work.

question: Q-binding
name: USACE CWMS Data API (cwms-data.usace.army.mil/cwms-data)
geoCoverage: US (offices LRH LRL LRN LRP MVK MVS SAM SAS SPA SWF SWT ... NWDP NWDM)
reason: Default units are SI (m): pass unit=EN. Catalog extents are frozen (latest-time ~2026-09-14 on every series) so liveness must be probed with a data query. Offices NWK/NWO/NWP/NWS/NWW/POA/POH/SAC/SPN have zero public series; their data sit under offices NWDP (NWW/NWP/NWS Columbia basin) and NWDM (Missouri mainstem).
notes: Reproduces Hartwell: SAS hourly pool silent 116.9 h (stale) while USGS 02187010 is live.

question: Q-binding
name: USACE Access2Water reporting API
dataType: project locations with NIDID alias, latest forebay/pool elevation, operator levels (Top of Normal, Top/Bottom of Flood, Top of Inactive)
reason: Single GET per district returns every project with geometry, NIDID alias and published conservation/flood levels: best single source for DIRECT_OPERATOR_POOL, operatorPlan and floodDroughtContext evidence. No history endpoint here; history comes from CWMS Data API (office NWDP/NWDM etc.).

question: Q-binding
name: USBR RISE API
reason: 233 daily non-modeled elevation series; location-to-item link only via catalog-record relationships; filters use dateTime[after]/dateTime[before]. Data lag up to ~2 days.

question: Q-binding
name: TWDB Water Data for Texas reservoirs
dataType: daily reservoir elevation, conservation pool elevation, per-reservoir history CSV
reason: State-compiled relay of USACE/river-authority data, so not counted as independent corroboration. Provides conservation-pool elevation as an independent check of directory fullPoolFt.

question: Q-binding
name: NOAA NWPS gauges API
dataType: observed pool elevation (pedts HP) at 903 gauges
reason: One bulk call returns all gauges with latest observation (13 MB). No long history; relay of USACE/USGS data, so counted as live check only, not as independent corroboration or history.

question: Q-binding
name: NOAA CO-OPS Great Lakes water level
reason: Stations are at harbours, named for the town; lake identity needs polygons (the five Great Lakes have none in the engine set).

question: Q-binding
name: TVA RestApi (locations, observed-data-48-hours, operating-guide)
dataType: hourly reservoir elevation, daily guide curve and operating zone
reason: Needs a browser User-Agent and Accept: application/json (plain curl is served the Cloudflare/ServiceStack HTML). 43 locations reachable, includes Cumberland dams (Barkley, Center Hill, Cordell Hull, Dale Hollow, Old Hickory, Wolf Creek, J Percy Priest). History beyond the 2-year guide is not available from TVA.

question: Q-binding
name: National Inventory of Dams (USACE) via hosted ArcGIS FeatureServer NID_v1
dataType: dam points, names, rivers, owners, purposes, storage
reason: Paged download works (46 pages of 2000). Official nid.sec.usace.army.mil/api/nation/csv returns 403 and /api/dams/* 404 for anonymous callers (see source 11).

question: Q-binding
name: NID official API / bulk export (nid.sec.usace.army.mil)
reason: csv endpoint 403; gpkg redirects to an S3 docs URL; dams search routes not found. The hosted FeatureServer in source 10 supersedes it.

org: Internet of Water / Western Water Data Hub

question: Q-binding

reason: Data call works (ORO checked) but there is no machine-readable national station index to auto-match lakes; needs a curated station list. Only the California lakes outside USACE/USBR/USGS coverage would use it.
